goal: Close Android phase2.5 E2E gaps and move lane status from partial to success by implementing save/refine runtime, stage-chain UI/API integration, and desk read path with dual-device proof.

inputs.description: Gap report and partial verdict details.
CT implementation directives from Android lane.

constraints.notes: Step A/B bridge is mandatory. Narrative-only completion is forbidden.

acceptance: CreateNarrative refine/save buttons are implemented with real API calls and retry/error UX.
Plan-first and Focus-first stage API chains are wired and visible in Android UI state.
OCR image_event_id is linked into reflect evidence_links with real IDs.
Desk read path shows persisted session/log outcomes to users.
Same-window physical+emulator evidence is attached with schema-valid canonical result.

risk.note: Without runtime E2E proof, Android lane can remain partial while upstream lanes are pass.

next_actions: Implement missing runtime handlers and stage-chain wiring.
Run SC-A/SC-B/SC-C/SC-D scenario evidence capture on dual devices.
Publish schema-valid Android iteration-2 result and mirrored artifacts.
